method: the method handling message formatting that processes different content blocks (including ToolResultBlock)
intended_behavior: Modify the condition that triggers flushing content_blocks upon encountering a ToolResultBlock. Instead of flushing whenever content_blocks is non-empty, flush only if content_blocks is non-empty and there is no ongoing tool_result block being processed (i.e., if content_blocks and not has_tool_result). This change allows multiple tool_results to be merged into a single user message, ensuring compliance with DeepSeek's message format requirements while preserving existing formatting for other cases.
